title: Shoreham Community Market
summary: Locally run monthly market beside Shoreham Tennis Club: arts, crafts, music, food, kids' activities, yoga, dogs welcome. Third Sunday September to May.
recurrenceNote: Monthly – 3rd Sunday of month (September–May season only)
suitableFor: Families; dog walkers; community locals; artisan shoppers
accessibilityNotes: Near tennis club; grassed area; uneven ground
weatherDependency: Outdoor – weather dependent; September to May season
nearbyAttractions: Shoreham Beach; Merricks wineries; Balnarring Village
suggestedItineraryPairing: Morning market then Shoreham beach picnic
editorVerdict: Small, scrappy and entirely unpretentious. The Shoreham locals' market that quietly does what bigger ones forget to.
editorNote:
Shoreham Community Market is the unhurried third-Sunday-of-the-month version of a Peninsula market: arts and crafts, a music stage, kids' activities, a yoga class on the lawn, and food that doesn't pretend to be anything other than market food.

It runs September through May only (closed across winter), which makes the shoulder months the smartest visit. Park, wander, eat, walk down to Shoreham Beach for the back end of the morning.

Dog-friendly, pram-fine on the grass, no need to plan. Good for a slow Sunday when you don't want a crowd.
